item.tib: gsang gcod kyi sgrub thabs shes bya blo yi nyi ma
item.coloph: ces pa 'di dag gzhung dang sgrub thabs phyag bzhes rnams la brten nas/ skyung sprul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis grogs mched kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rang gi nyams su blang bde ba dang / bstan pa mi nub gsal ba dang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyabs pa sogs la dmigs nas/ dpe cha 'ga' la lta rtog dang / gnyer len gyi brtson 'grus nas mang po byas shing / me pho stag gi lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes la dben pa'i gnas mchog mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du bsdebs shing brtsams pa ni/ phyogs dus kun tu nyi ma'i zer ltar gsal zhing khyab par gyur cig/

item.tib: gsang gcod kyi sgrub thabs shes bya blo yi nyi ma
item.coloph: ces pa 'di dag gzhung dang sgrub thabs phyag bzhes rnams la brten nas/ rkyang (skyang) sprul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis/ grogs mched kyis bskul ngor dang / rang gi nyams len bde ba dang / bstan pa mi nub gsal ba dang / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyobs pa sogs la dmigs nas/ dpe cha 'ga' la lta (blta) rtog dang / gnyor (gnyer) len gyis brtson 'grus mang po byas shing / me pho stag gi lor hor zla gsum pa'i tshes/ dben pa'i gnas mchog mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du bsdebs shing brtsoms (brtsams) pa 'di ni/ phyogs bcu kun tu nyi ma'i zer ltar gsal zhing khyab par gyur cig/
